description: Hand-built fixture, not a sample of production. Its job is to prove the harness and the annotation lifecycle compute correctly, on a population small enough to verify by hand: 12 candidates, of which 8 rows have a real topic, 2 are genuine Other, and 2 were dropped, one per cause. One contested item is adjudicated and one agreed label is overridden. Two of the 8 carry a body. The labels and rulings are ours, not an annotator's, and no model decision may rest on them.
